learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the limitless power of imagination and discover how using our creative gifts selflessly can bring joy to the world!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🎨 The Gift of the Magic Brush
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our story begins with an ordinary but pure-hearted artist who discovers a miraculous brush. Whatever they paint with this brush suddenly springs to life and becomes completely real!
Instead of asking for gold or riches, the artist uses the magical brush to help poor villagers. They paint food, tools, and water, showing that true art serves the community.
When greedy people try to steal the brush for selfish reasons, the artist uses cleverness and the power of art to defeat them. It teaches us that magical gifts belong only in kind hands.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ If I Had a Magic Brush
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you found a magical paintbrush that brings drawings to life. Write down three things you would paint to help your neighborhood and explain why!

quick_recap: ⭐ A special magic brush turns beautiful imaginations into living reality.
⭐ The artist selflessly uses this incredible power to help those who are in need.
⭐ The story proves that creativity paired with a kind heart is the greatest magic of all.
